task_instance: Perform the skill's core deliverable: a 'Review fireflies governed integration architecture' pass over a sample staging integration (a Webhooks V2 transcript.completed intake that fetches authorized summary fields and writes derived CRM notes), producing a bounded architecture design plan and a redacted pass/fail receipt.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and its references file (references/official-docs.md); the skill is a system-design/review deliverable (allowed-tools Read,Glob,Grep,Write,Edit; compatibility note states live Fireflies work needs network but design/review does not). Created sample input sample-repo/integration.config.json (a realistic current integration describing principal, event types, stores, gaps). Produced the deliverable architecture-review.md: actor/boundary mapping, the five Current-Contract trust boundaries, a gap table (G1-G7) against the requested outcome, a target design diagram (edge verify -> ack -> idempotent queue -> minimized bearer GraphQL read -> isolated raw/summarized stores -> derived CRM writer), a threat model (replay, duplicate, stale, leakage), approval-boundary triggers, and the required Output surface. Produced receipt.md with deterministic re-checks (boundary coverage 5/5 PASS, field-minimization PASS, secret/meeting-content leakage scan PASS, requested-outcome coverage PASS) plus explicitly recorded unresolved uncertainty that the live first-party schema/limits/mutation references are placeholders unreachable in this runtime and web use is disallowed, so field selection is a pinned design decision not re-verified live. Verified the deliverable against the skill's Output and Validation sections: all required fields present, no API key/bearer/signing-secret or meeting-derived content in any artifact. All work done with text file tools only; no code executed, no network, no MCP/connector calls. Files: architecture-review.md, receipt.md, sample-repo/integration.config.json, result.json in the work directory.
